exercises.prompt: Select the correctly inflected badal: 'I read half of the book.'
exercises.explanation: الكِتَابَ is accusative (direct object), so its part-of-whole badal (نِصْفَ) must also be accusative: نِصْفَهُ.

feedback.rule: Al-badal matches the exact grammatical case of its antecedent (al-mubdal minhu).

exercises.prompt: True or False: In الخَلِيفَةُ عُمَرُ ('the Caliph ʿUmar'), عُمَرُ is an identical badal (بَدَلٌ مُطَابِقٌ).
exercises.explanation: True. A proper name following a title/role is an identical badal sharing the title's case.
